paper.title: Pythia: Exploiting Workflow Predictability for Efficient Agent-Native LLM Serving

faithful: workflow profiler / probabilistic finite automaton over a ROLE alphabet
a loop is expressed as a REPEATED role, so the occurrence suffix is dropped
low-probability transition pruning as the bounded probable future
expected remaining DISTANCE (number of future role transitions) from the automaton
completion-aware priority S_completion = 1 / E[D_remaining] with omega1 = 1
adapted: role key composed from role:action_family:raw_action, because the paper's alphabet entry is the current agent_id and a bare VideoSeek role is too coarse
the finite horizon is OUR fixed, train-independent step limit and is NOT the paper's bound, which prunes transitions and applies repetition bounds to looping roles
indexing by the candidate's own role (the agent_id Pythia exposes on a request)
deviation: H=6 fixed finite-horizon recursion replaces Pythia's bounded-regex / repetition-bound representation for expected remaining-distance estimation. The paper bounds its automaton with low-probability transition filtering plus repetition bounds on looping roles (engineer^{3,6}); H=6 is our fixed, train-independent approximation.

speculative and prefix cache routing, model-replica idleness, autoscaling, and the original serving/batching infrastructure are not migrated, being outside the unified GPU abstraction. The paper's Algorithm 3 priority carries both S_completion and S_unblock.
omissions: cache routing, prefix caching, model-replica idleness, autoscaling: outside this GPU abstraction
S_unblock omitted, because the simulator has no model-server queue to attach it to; omega2 = 0
defects_closed_before_freeze: template.baseline used as the alphabet, which is not a role alphabet at all
the consumer indexed by the last COMPLETED role while V excludes the role it is indexed by, double-counting the current candidate (80 instead of 60 on A->B->C with 10/20/40)
the finite horizon was described as the paper's bound, which it is not
prohibited_after_freeze: the role alphabet definition, including the dropped occurrence suffix
PFA structure, transition semantics, pruning threshold and renormalisation
freeze_breaking_exception: A reproducible correctness bug only, recorded as a freeze-breaking fix and never retuned to improve results.
wording_correction: Do not write that the finite horizon replaces a stationary solve: Pythia does not estimate this quantity by solving a stationary system. Write that it replaces the bounded-regex / repetition-bound representation.
variant_rule: Adjusting any of the above requires a NEW VARIANT; it must not overwrite the frozen baseline.

freeze_breaking_fixes.defect: The priority was ranked by a DURATION: the finite-horizon recursion accumulated per-role millisecond means and the live consumer added the candidate's runtime_p50 + load, making the arm a duration-weighted / SRTF-flavoured priority. Pythia Algorithm 3 uses the expected remaining DISTANCE in steps on the probabilistic regex.
freeze_breaking_fixes.fix: V(role) is now the expected NUMBER of future role transitions (a transition to <end> is not a role and is not counted) and S_completion = 1 / (1 + V(role)); the consumer adds no millisecond term. Profiler schema bumped to pythia-role-pfa-v2 so an ms-valued artifact fails closed.
freeze_breaking_fixes.verification: tests/test_pythia_fidelity.py adds test_the_distance_does_not_depend_on_durations and re-derives the chain/fan-out values in steps; 13/13 gate.
